description: Hand-selected, decision-relevant facts per app. Each fact is backed by a verbatim quote on an official page (checked by scripts/check-ground-truth.mts). goldDifficulty follows /method's rubric; cost does not raise difficulty unless access is partner/sales-gated.

facts.statement: There is no provider review before real users can authorize a GitHub OAuth app.
facts.quote: In "Authorization callback URL", type the callback URL of your app.

facts.statement: A GitHub OAuth app can register up to 10 callback URLs.
facts.quote: You can enter up to 10 callback URLs.

facts.statement: A redirect_uri that doesn't match the registered callback URL yields error=redirect_uri_mismatch.
facts.quote: If you provide a redirect_uri that doesn't match what you've registered with your application, GitHub will redirect to the registered callback URL

facts.statement: Authenticated REST API requests are limited to 5,000 per hour per user.
facts.quote: All of these requests count towards your personal rate limit of 5,000 requests per hour.

facts.statement: GitHub recommends GitHub Apps over OAuth apps (fine-grained permissions, can act as the app).
facts.quote: In general, GitHub Apps are preferred over OAuth apps. Both OAuth apps and GitHub Apps use OAuth 2.0.

facts.statement: To install the app outside your own workspace you must activate Public Distribution.
facts.quote: Click Activate Public Distribution . Once distribution is enabled, you'll get access to an embeddable Add to Slack button

facts.statement: OAuth redirect URLs must use HTTPS.
facts.quote: The redirect_uri must use HTTPS.

facts.statement: Non-Marketplace (unlisted) commercially distributed apps created after May 29, 2025 get conversations.history limited to 1 request per minute.
facts.quote: The new rate limits will be updated to allow 1 request per minute and will return a maximum of 15 objects per request.

facts.statement: Slack Marketplace functional review can take up to 10 weeks for new submissions.
facts.quote: the functional review takes up to 10 weeks for new submissions

facts.statement: Marketplace submission requires the app to be installed on at least 10 active workspaces.
facts.quote: Your app has been installed on 10 or more active workspaces

facts.statement: Apps in Testing publishing status are limited to 100 test users.
facts.quote: Projects configured with a publishing status of Testing are limited to up to 100 test users listed in the OAuth consent screen.

facts.statement: In Testing mode, test-user authorizations (and refresh tokens) expire after seven days.
facts.quote: Authorizations by a test user will expire seven days from the time of consent.

facts.statement: Apps that access restricted-scope data through a server must pass an annual third-party security assessment.
facts.quote: must go through a security assessment from Google-empanelled

facts.statement: Restricted scope verification can take several weeks.
facts.quote: the restricted scopes verification process can potentially take several weeks to complete

facts.statement: Brand verification is required first and typically takes 2-3 business days.
facts.quote: step first, which typically takes 2-3 business days

facts.statement: Full mailbox access (https://mail.google.com/) and gmail.readonly are restricted scopes.
facts.quote: Read, compose, send, and permanently delete all your email from Gmail.

facts.statement: New apps start in development mode, limited to up to 5 authenticated users.
facts.quote: Up to 5 authenticated Spotify users can use an app that is in development mode

facts.statement: In development mode every user must be added to the app's allowlist.
facts.quote: Each Spotify user who installs your app will need to be added to your app's allowlist before they can use it.

facts.statement: The app owner needs Spotify Premium for development mode apps to work.
facts.quote: The app owner must have a Spotify Premium account for apps in development mode to function.

facts.statement: Since May 15, 2025 extended quota is only granted to organizations, not individuals.
facts.quote: as of May 15th 2025, Spotify only accepts applications from organizations (not individuals)

facts.statement: Extended quota requires at least 250k monthly active users.
facts.quote: Maintaining a minimum of active users (at least 250k MAUs)

facts.statement: localhost is not allowed as a redirect URI; use 127.0.0.1 loopback or HTTPS.
facts.quote: localhost is not allowed as redirect URI.

facts.statement: Users can't consent to most newly registered multitenant apps that aren't publisher verified (when risk-based step-up consent is on).
facts.quote: users can't consent to most newly registered multitenant apps that aren't publisher verified

facts.statement: Publisher verification needs a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account (Partner One ID).
facts.quote: The developer must have a Partner One ID for a valid Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account that has completed the verification process.

facts.statement: Redirect URIs must use https, with exceptions for some localhost URIs.
facts.quote: Redirect URIs must begin with the scheme https , with exceptions for some localhost redirect URIs.

facts.statement: Redirect URIs are case-sensitive.
facts.quote: Redirect URIs are case-sensitive and must match the case of the URL path of your running application.

facts.statement: Tenant admins can restrict user consent to apps from verified publishers, so some customers will need admin consent.
facts.quote: Allow limited user consent only for apps from verified publishers and apps that are registered in your tenant

facts.statement: New apps default to the Starter tier with 5 connections.
facts.quote: New apps default to the starter tier with 5 connections.

facts.statement: Moving to the Core tier allows up to 50 connections.
facts.quote: Moving up to Core will give you up to 50 connections.

facts.statement: Listing on the Xero App Store requires the Plus tier or above.
facts.quote: To be listed on the App Store, you will need to be in the Plus tier or above.

facts.statement: Core costs $35 AUD per month; Starter has no charge.
facts.quote: Monthly Tier Fee No charge $35 AUD $245 AUD $1445 AUD

facts.statement: Higher tiers require app certification.
facts.quote: Prerequisites App Certification App Certification App Certification

facts.statement: The X API uses pay-per-usage pricing with no subscriptions.
facts.quote: The X API uses pay-per-usage pricing with no subscriptions.

facts.statement: You buy credits upfront in the Developer Console and they are deducted per request.
facts.quote: Purchase credits upfront in the Developer Console. Credits are deducted as you make API requests.

facts.statement: Different endpoints have different costs.
facts.quote: Different endpoints have different costs.

facts.statement: Apps requesting advanced access may need to be connected to a verified business (Business Verification).
facts.quote: apps requesting advanced access for permissions may have to be connected to a verified business

facts.statement: Marketing API Full Access requires 500 Marketing API calls in the past 15 days (threshold lowered from 1,500).
facts.quote: The revised qualification threshold for Full Access has been reduced from 1,500 to

facts.statement: Standard Access was renamed Limited Access and Advanced Access renamed Full Access for the Marketing API tier.
facts.quote: Ads Management Standard Access is now Marketing API Access Tier
